justifications.durability: the categorise-first gate is pinned by a parametrized test over analysis_code/container/archive/modeling_data that asserts scan/expand/enrich all follow the category rather than high facet scores, by the container-claim query test, by the stored-score refresh test asserting scan_indexes == CODE_BEARING_PURPOSES, and by the AUC test asserting the 0.9244 reproduction; I independently reproduced the declared negative control (the facet-composite gate makes test_scored_container_claim_excludes_archive fail, EXIT=1, indep-negative-control.log) with the unmutated head green. The shortfall is that the container/archive exclusion is pinned by query text and a FakeGraph that returns the row unconditionally, so no unit test exercises the archive path returning no claim.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the focused gate at 4d6919fdf (12 passed, EXIT=0, indep-focused-gate.log), the exclusion suite at head (46 passed, EXIT=0, indep-exclusions.log) and tests/discovery at both arms (base 1428 passed EXIT=0; head 1434 passed, 1 failed EXIT=1); the AUC test reproduced 0.9244 through the production path_category_gate; and I reproduced the negative control independently; base and head trees were extracted with git archive and run with the shared environment. The gaps are that the reviewed manifest stores no baseline_suite/after_suite, and exclusion-gate.log's header revision cannot produce its own passing result.
justifications.fit: all six commits use conventional feat/fix/test/data/docs subjects with bodies stating the mechanism and the covered cases; the new symbols (path_category_gate, CODE_BEARING_PURPOSES, DATA_PURPOSES, SKIPPED_PURPOSES, EXPANSION_GATE, refresh_stored_path_gates) name what the code does, and no message, symbol, filename or comment carries a plan, section, ticket or version identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node's category gate is implemented in production, admits scored containers while refusing archives, refreshes stored scan relevance without re-judging, and reproduces node 1's 0.9244 AUC through paths.scorer.path_category_gate; the folded follow-ons are taken (description typed str|None with the describe-failure cost assertion, and labelled-paths-v2.json renamed to labelled-path-categories.json). One done-when element — that a scored archive is not claimed — rests on a query-shape assertion plus the live log rather than a behavioural test.
justifications.reuse: refresh_stored_path_gates recomputes scan relevance from path_purpose_probs read through the graph rather than re-querying a model, the expansion predicate is factored into one EXPANSION_GATE string shared by the status, pending-work and claim queries instead of being duplicated, and the questions and threshold come from build_path_judgment_questions and get_path_scan_threshold. The one lapse is that path_scan_relevance/SCAN_FACETS are left as dead production code that only the out-of-scope red test still imports.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 514d32ea8..4d6919fdf touches only the declared code, test and evidence paths, with no unrelated reformatting; the one out-of-scope test that fails (test_path_judgments.py) was correctly left untouched and declared as a follow-on rather than edited. The only scope observation is the manifest's over-declaration of description.py.
